rationale.correct: Step 1: Envelope sensible load = 400 m² × 500 BTU/hr per m² (commercial, source: ASHRAE 90.1) ÷ 3.412 ≈ 58.5 kW. Step 2: Occupant sensible load = 40 persons × 100 W/person (office activity, source: ASHRAE 62.1 Table 6.2.2.1) = 4 kW. Step 3: Equipment load = 20 kW (given). Step 4: Total sensible = 58.5 + 4 + 20 = 82.5 kW ≈ 83 kW. This calculation excludes latent load (occupant moisture, infiltration); latent would be ~24 kW (30–40% of sensible for tropical climate), bringing total to ~107 kW ≈ 30 TR. Source: ALE-UTIL-002-04 Module Inverse Computation section; ASHRAE 62.1 Table 6.2.2.1.
rationale.takeaway: Commercial sensible load breakdown: envelope (~58%), occupants (~5%), equipment (~24%) sum to total sensible; must add latent load separately (30–40% of sensible in tropical climate) for complete cooling load sizing.
